description: A repo-native product design workspace with PRD handoff, responsive Auto Layout, frontend generation, and visual implementation comparison.

tools.name: put_design_resource
tools.description: Store an image or font once in the repo-native content-addressed resource library from small inline Base64 or workspace Base64 chunk files, then return its stable descriptor for imageRef or fontRef.

base64.description: Inline Base64 for small resources. For larger resources, omit this and provide source_paths.

source_paths.description: Ordered workspace-relative .txt files containing consecutive Base64 chunks for a larger resource.

save.description: Save the updated design descriptor after storing the content. Defaults to true.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact in-memory stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata.

tools.name: get_design_metadata
tools.description: Read the active design's indexed-pages capacity model, persistence mode, page catalog, canvas, color tokens, selection, compact active-page layer index, and machine-readable layout contract.

tools.name: read_product_brief
tools.description: Read a workspace-local Markdown, MDX, or text PRD and return a structured product brief with goals, audience, stable requirement IDs, screens, acceptance criteria, and constraints for design planning.

tools.name: search_design_system
tools.description: Search the current document's reusable color tokens and component masters by semantic name, id, notes, or color value before creating duplicate local design primitives.

query.description: Case-insensitive semantic name, stable id, note text, or color value to search.

limit.description: Maximum matches returned for each result kind. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_design_context
tools.description: Read the complete CodeShell Design v3 document when it fits the Agent result budget, one indexed page by page_id, or one bounded node subtree by stable node id. Oversized reads fail with guidance to narrow by page or subtree. Nested x/y values are materialized absolute-canvas geometry; flow children are owned by parent layout while layoutPositioning:absolute children retain x/y ownership.

node_id.description: Optional stable node id. Omit to return the full repository document.

page_id.description: Optional page id from metadata. When node_id is omitted, returns only this page; when both are present, verifies that the subtree belongs to the page.

max_depth.description: Maximum descendant depth for a node subtree. Defaults to 32 and is ignored when node_id is omitted. Start with 1 or 2 for large imported screens.

tools.name: use_design
tools.description: Apply a guarded design transaction, refresh the canvas, and return an immediate audit summary. Pass the latest metadata stateRevision; manual coordinates are preserved and only affected auto-layout containers reflow. A net-zero request returns noOp=true and no transaction id, preserving the latest real rollback token.

effectClipping.description: Marks a deliberately clipped visual effect measured from imported HTML.

contentClipping.description: Marks child overflow clipping as deliberate, typically when measured from imported HTML.

x.description: Absolute canvas X for a root/manual/absolute-positioned node. Never make it parent-relative; omit it only for a flow child.

y.description: Absolute canvas Y for a root/manual/absolute-positioned node. Never make it parent-relative; omit it only for a flow child.

fillPaints.description: Bounded editable paint stack. Use null to remove it; a fill-only update explicitly replaces the stack with a solid fill.

anyOf.description: Editable Figma paints in bottom-to-top order. Runtime additionally validates increasing gradient stop positions and invertible handle geometry.

strokeLayoutExcluded.description: Native source provenance for inside strokes excluded from an H/V Frame or Component content inset. Null removes it; omitted defaults to included CSS effective padding.

textMeasurement.description: Legacy HTML text measurement marker. Figma imports persist signature-bound textMetrics receipts; this marker cannot create those receipts.

layout.description: Container layout. Horizontal, vertical, and grid own flow-child positions.

layoutReverse.description: Reverses the main-axis order while preserving source sibling order.

layoutPositioning.description: Absolute children keep absolute canvas x/y and are excluded from their parent's flow.

tokens.description: Complete replacement color-token set. Preserve every token you still need; changing a value under the same token name propagates that color through the design.

id.description: Required stable semantic id. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single-purpose hyphen-separated words so later operations can reference the node deterministically.

parent_id.description: Parent container id, or null/omitted for the canvas root. Parenting never changes x/y into relative coordinates.

before_id.description: Optional sibling id used to place the new node before that sibling.

properties.description: Node fields. Root/manual nodes must include absolute canvas x and y; direct children of auto-layout containers must omit x and y.

changes.description: Fields to change. Updating a container x/y moves its complete subtree. Do not set x/y on an auto-layout child.

parent_id.description: Destination container id, or null for the canvas root. Manual geometry stays in absolute canvas coordinates.

before_id.description: Optional sibling id in the destination.

changes.description: Document name, field-wise canvas patch, or complete token-set replacement. Preserve unchanged tokens.

switch.description: Switch to the new page. Defaults to true.

save.description: Save to the active repo file after applying. Defaults to true.

expected_revision.description: Optional exact revision returned by get_design_metadata. The transaction fails before mutation if the active revision changed.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact in-memory stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata. The transaction fails before mutation if a human, Agent, undo/redo, page switch, workspace switch, or unsaved edit changed the live design.

tools.name: import_html
tools.description: Convert workspace HTML/CSS through pinned html2figma DesignNode to editable v3 with stable IDs, a clipped viewport and compatibility report. Verify inline images/fonts, then persist resources before replacing the canvas. Scripts and network requests are blocked. Local binary files use the panel's folder chooser. Complete portable files restore directly in Figma.

path.description: Workspace-relative .html or .htm path. The importer may read up to 20 relative local CSS files referenced by this document.

root_selector.description: CSS selector for the first-viewport region to convert. Defaults to html; fully offscreen descendants are omitted.

viewport_width.description: Browser viewport width in CSS pixels. Defaults to 1440.

viewport_height.description: Browser viewport height in CSS pixels. Defaults to 900.

save.description: Save the converted design to the active .codesign.json file. Defaults to true.

expected_revision.description: Optional exact design-file revision from get_design_metadata.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact live stateRevision from get_design_metadata. Import fails if the canvas changes while HTML is rendering.

tools.name: generate_frontend
tools.description: Generate editable HTML/CSS for one design page, or an offline multi-page interactive prototype with saved links and responsive routes. Optionally include local review comments.

page_id.description: Optional page id from metadata. Defaults to the active page.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata.

prototype.description: When true, export all pages and the saved prototype interactions. Defaults to false.

include_comments.description: Include project review comments in the interactive prototype. Defaults to false.

tools.name: compare_frontend
tools.description: Render a workspace HTML implementation at the design viewport, recapture it into Design v3, compare stable layer IDs, geometry, styles, and pixels against the active design page, and save a Markdown report for the next refinement pass.

report_path.description: Optional workspace-relative report path. Defaults beside the HTML implementation.

root_selector.description: Optional CSS selector for the implementation region. Defaults to body.

viewport_width.description: Comparison viewport width. Defaults to the design canvas width.

viewport_height.description: Comparison viewport height. Defaults to the design canvas height.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata.

tools.name: rollback_design
tools.description: Safely roll back the most recent use_design or import_html transaction when no design or repository revision has changed since it completed.

transaction_id.description: Exact transactionId returned by the most recent use_design call.

save.description: Save the restored design to the active repo file. Defaults to true.

tools.name: validate_design
tools.description: Validate every page. Counts and grouped causes cover all issues; filter by code/severity and page through details with offset/limit. valid=false for any issue; renderSafe identifies blocking failures.

tools.name: get_design_screenshot
tools.description: Render a complete page or one node region from any page as an image so the Agent can visually inspect layout, hierarchy, clipping, and polish after edits. The call fails if the source state changes while the image is rendering.

node_id.description: Optional globally unique node id to crop and enlarge. Its page is resolved automatically.

page_id.description: Optional page id for a complete-page image or to assert the page that contains node_id. Defaults to the active page.

max_width.description: Maximum screenshot width in pixels. Defaults to 1200.

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Save the current design, or manage files with action:create/open/save_as. New paths are create-only; save_as retains resources and saved review/prototype attachments. Default action is save. Requires the latest stateRevision.

path.description: New .codesign.json path. Existing files are rejected in create mode.

discard_changes.description: Explicitly discard unsaved changes for create/open; otherwise save first.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata.

tools.name: get_design_comments
tools.description: Read project design-review threads by page, node or status. Lists provide bounded text summaries; use thread_id and reply_offset to read full text and five replies at a time.

tools.name: update_design_comments
tools.description: Create an anchored review comment, reply to a thread, or mark a thread resolved/reopened. Persists independently with concurrency checks; requires the current design state revision.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata.

tools.name: exchange_figma
tools.description: Prepare and audit Figma JSON before import; create an independent design or explicitly replace the current canvas. Commit a preparationId after review. Export source-aware Figma transfers. Legacy path-only imports replace the current canvas.

path.description: Legacy input path for import, or output path for export. Prefer source_path for new imports.

expected_state_revision.description: Required exact stateRevision returned by get_design_metadata.

source_path.description: Figma source JSON or prepared multipart manifest. Defaults to creating a new design.

target_path.description: New .codesign.json path. Existing files are rejected in create mode.

mode.description: New imports default to create. replace targets the current file. Legacy path-only imports retain replace behavior.

preparation_id.description: Exact preparationId from prepare, bound to source hash, target and current state.

allow_blocking.description: Explicitly allow a draft with blocking audit issues; never marks it deliverable.
